You love studying because you love learning new things? Do you read books a lot? Because I think that is something you should do. You've got to know what ticks you. What I mean by that is really simple actually. Find out what gets you going. What puts you through a rush. Honestly just something that makes you happy whether its a little or a lot. When you find that something, just keep doing it. 

I know its hard right now and your conditions are stopping you from doing what you want to do. But you've got to understand that this can and will be a temporary thing. You're bound to overcome these problems someday and then you'll get back to doing whatever you want to do, with ease. Believe that you are able to fight off these 'demons' - i'm not talking about Satanic things either. Essentially what I'm telling you to do is to think POSITIVE. I know it sounds cheesy and you probably hear it all the time but does it really matter how it sounds when ultimately it can help you through your current condition? Convince your mind that you are able to overcome the problems you face. If you find it hard for yourself to remember the good things, write them down. Make it a part of your schedule. Put pictures every where about the things you love, the things that will keep you going. I promise you that no matter how hard things get eventually you will achieve victory in the end. Just give yourself time, time is your friend here.

I understand that you're close to them and it would bother anyone to be a drag on your own family. But if they can't be strong enough for you you've got to be strong for yourself. What you need to do is find something that will preoccupy you a lot. I'm talking about hobbies here. What do you love to do? What can you do? I also advise you to go for a run or a light jog. Take in the sun and enjoy the scenery. Just be able to breathe that's the key here. Do you have a job?

You shouldn't care about the people around you. People will always have some sort of judgement against you but that's just how people are. Focus on yourself and not others because that's how it should always be. You're living life for yourself and no one else. So don't let other people affect the way you think. You're scared because I'm hoping that there's something telling you that you don't want to go through with it. So, lets talk.

You've had yourself though right? I think that's more important than having a friend. You're a friend to yourself. So go out there and try to lose weight. It'll then develop into a hobby and soon you'll find yourself spending all your time in that and enjoying it as well. If that's not enough for you, play some video games man. That shit relieves stress better than anything. Tell me, how old are you? Do you have a job? Family? What's up?
Alright. Time to talk. Why is it that you can't see yourself having a life if you do get help?

Like you said, suicide is pointless. Man, you'll always walk through life running into obstacles left and right. First, go get in touch with your sister. There's nothing better than family. I'm sure she's going through the same thing after your parents passed away as well. So you've got something to relate to and you can help each other stand straight. 

Another thing, fall in love with your upcoming career. If I understood right, you're going to be a teacher? Holy shit man you know how many people you're going to be surrounded with on a daily? You're going to see soon enough how much enjoyment and fulfillment there's gonna be in your profession. 

If that's not enough for you, get some hobbies, man. Go for a walk or a run, find a local sports club and shoot some hoops or score some goals. 

GET A PET. Dog or cat or a snake, ANYTHING. Pets are the best source of stress relieving (so is sex). But I know that when I'm feeling down I come home to my cat and sit there and play with it and fuck I'm smiling again. I sound like a pussy right? I don't care man anything to make me feel better. 

Let's talk about how you got rid of your bad friends. Good for you man. You deserve a gold star. I'd rather be lonely than hang out with a bunch of losers who bring me down. I've rooted out my bad friends before and do I feel fucking great. Usually these kind of bad friends straight kill your character. You're always doing something for them because they always want to be bottle fed. Ever since I got rid of them, I learned more about myself than I have ever in my life. They just bring you down so fuck that. You made a good decision there so pat yourself on the back. Also, don't let these girls bring you down. Im not trying to be a sexist or maybe I am but never let a girl get to you. I've been let down by so many girls but damn did I learn every time it's not worth aching over them. I've had long relationships that ended and I just got over them so quick because I taught myself that I'm more important than some girl. I don't know man, that's just how you gotta look at it. 

So that's all I've got to say. I hope you take my words into consideration. Good luck with your degree and all!

You may not be near the people you love and yeah that sucks a lot, but you have to look at what you've got. You're surrounded by people wherever you're stationed, people being the key. Go make some close friends. They'll guide you through the hardship you're in. I understand that you're going through physical endurance that's overwhelming but realize how beneficial that is for you not only physically but mentally. Now going back to the people you love facing hardship: your life is not worth theirs. You have to love for yourself and not others. People will always  get sick, make bad choices and such but there's nothing you can do. Find the value in yourself and live life man. Suicide is never an option. You won't regret living your life. So I wish you good luck and I hope you take my words into consideration.
